name.description: State key name: <sales order>-<line>; it names the server, so it is a hostname label that every provider accepts.

flavor.description: Order flavor; selects the catalog of the root.

size.description: Catalog size the root maps to a server type.

region.description: Catalog region the root maps to provider settings.

ssh_public_key.description: Workspace public key installed for the first login.

order.description: Survey variables of provision, destroy, unlock and dns: the order line whose <SALES_ORDER>-<LINE> is the name.

SALES_ORDER.description: Sales Order: a letter first, at most 56 characters, so the joined name stays a hostname label.

LINE.description: Line of the Sales Order: digits only without a leading zero, so the last '-' of the name separates both and 7 and 007 cannot name the same line twice.

host_name.description: Survey variable HOST of dns create when it is no address: a fully qualified host name, the pattern workspace.py checks WORKSPACE_TARGETS with, that MUST be the host of a pair of WORKSPACE_TARGETS. create then writes a CNAME <DNS_LABEL>.<workspace>.<zone> to it and never resolves it; an address writes A or AAAA.

provider_token.description: Survey variable PROVIDER_TOKEN of provision and destroy: platform takes the provider token of the platform, workspace the customer's own token at tenant/data/<workspace>-provision/providers/<provider>; neither falls back to the other.

workspace.description: workspace.json the provision script writes into the task directory beside the root.
Workspace name ws-<id>: DNS suffix, Proxmox pool and Incus project.

zone.description: Deploy zone apex without trailing dot.

zone_id.description: Provider zone id: Route 53 hosted zone or Cloudflare zone; empty for knot.

catalog.description: services.semaphore.workspaces.catalog.<provider>, copied beside the root as catalog.json: per flavor the sizes and regions the root maps to provider settings.
